title: lennrt/palomar-formalizations
summary: A Lean formalization of the paper's standard finite-word semantics for k-uniform two-word π-representability, its neighbourhood-trace bound binomial(k(|A|+1),k)^2, the explicit 20-by-741322 bit-incidence graph B20, and the theorem that B20 is not representable by two 2-uniform words. It also retains the companion's token-order bridge and exact arithmetic endpoints.

formalizes.title: An Explicit Obstruction to Uniform Two-Word π-Representability

review.reason: Lean formalization of word representability bounds and a specific 20-by-741322 incidence graph.
